entry.title: New: Bill 32 (2024) (Maui) — Agenda Ready
entry.content:
"A BILL FOR AN ORDINANCE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024 BUDGET FOR THE COUNTY OF MAUI, GENERAL BUDGET PROVISIONS, SECTION 18" The purpose of this bill is to amend the Fiscal Year 2024 Budget, General Budget Provisions, Section 18 by deleting "$55,000,000" and inserting "10 percent of the total operating budget"".

View on the council site
